prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photo for a personal gift website. A 35-year-old bakery owner with a short curly red bob places the first tray of fresh plain bread rolls on the counter of her newly opened bakery. Her 38-year-old partner with short dark hair and glasses steadies the open counter section beside her. They exchange a proud relieved smile. Use early-morning window light, flour-dusted practical clothes and believable tray support; no signage or prices. Warm family documentary photography with candid timing and unforced expressions. Vertical 4:5 cover composition. Keep faces and important hands above the lower fifth; normal continuous clothing or furniture forms the quiet lower area. Invent ordinary fictional people with distinct faces, realistic skin and believable age. Use warm paper, muted terracotta and natural surrounding colours without heavy filtering. Preserve correct anatomy, fingers, limbs and object geometry. One continuous real photograph: no fade, gradient mask, crossfade, compositing or synthetic caption band. No readable words, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, collages or grids.

Additional anatomy and composition requirements: The bakery owner is an ordinary freckled redhead with a round face, and the partner is a clean-shaven dark-haired adult with rectangular glasses. The owner uses exactly two natural hands to support one rectangular baking tray as it rests securely on a clean counter. The partner stands beside her and keeps a simple hinged counter section open with one hand. Make tray, rolls and counter physically coherent, without floating objects or fused hands. Vertical 4:5, with normal continuous counter and apron in the lower fifth; no fade, gradient, compositing or caption band.
review: Tray and the owner hands sit in the lower caption fifth despite the cover framing requirement. Regenerate from farther back with tray and hands higher in frame and plain counter foreground below; keep the otherwise plausible bakery scene.
